title: Static Pleated Keyboard Accordion
description: One original complete static low-poly keyboard accordion: two deep chamfer-cornered red end cases flank one continuous nine-fold bellows body. Fourteen separate pale long keys and ten raised short dark keys form a clearly readable stylized keyboard on its own dark backing; eighteen separate pale octagonal buttons form a three-by-six field on the opposite case. Every key, button, keyboard backing and bellows end has a complete finite opposed seat, with no hidden interpenetration. The bellows has continuous folded front, back, top and underside surfaces, with defined open valley clearances. Forty-six editable closed meshes and four constant opaque untextured PBR materials. Both full case bottom facets rest at Z=0. One prop, zero scenes. Metres are game-space proportions; native Z up, front -Y, ground-centred origin. Newly authored whole geometry, no imported instrument, piano, luggage or bag geometry.
